customManagers.description: Track pinned Alpine apk packages via Repology. IMPORTANT: bump alpine version in depNameTemplate when the base image changes (e.g. alpine_3_24 -> alpine_3_25)
Track NUT (Network UPS Tools) releases from GitHub
matchStrings: # NUT version to build from source\s+ARG NUT_VERSION=(?<currentValue>.*?)\n

packageRules.description: Alpine base image version bumps — manual review. APK pins and the Repology depNameTemplate must be hand-updated to match the new release, so this must NOT ride the automerge bundle. (Digest-only rebuilds still automerge via the non-major group.)
NUT source version — feat: prefix (minor bump via release-please), manual review required
